item.title: 3DS 2.4: draft, not a mandate
item.description: [neutral] So what for merchants: Watch the 3DS draft; do not schedule a mandatory migration on this source alone. EMVCo reports that draft Protocol and Core Functions v2.4 is available for Associate and Subscriber review. No global migration deadline is asserted. Who: 3DS servers, SDK providers and authentication teams. Effective: Not confirmed / not applicable. Official source: https://www.emvco.com/news-publications/emvco-newsletter-q3-2026/

item.title: 3DS approvals: conditional extension
item.description: [neutral] So what for merchants: Ask your 3DS provider whether its product qualifies for the extension. EMVCo’s Q3 update reports conditional approval extensions for eligible products intending to migrate to v2.4.0.0. Confirm product-specific eligibility. Who: 3DS product providers. Effective: Not confirmed / not applicable. Official source: https://www.emvco.com/news-publications/emvco-newsletter-q3-2026/

item.title: Agentic payments: intent framework draft
item.description: [neutral] So what for merchants: Separate consumer-intent design work from deployed network requirements. EMVCo’s draft framework introduces Intent Services for consumer-authorised intent. It is a specification-development step, not a deployed network mandate. Who: Agentic checkout and payment product teams. Effective: Not confirmed / not applicable. Official source: https://www.emvco.com/news-publications/emvco-newsletter-q3-2026/
